description:
Every neighborhood from which this point (e.g. the office) is reached within max_minutes, fastest first (zasieg w N minut).
Lists also neighborhoods with too few ads for a price (median_rent null), unlike rank_neighborhoods.

max_minutes.description: Max minutes from home to this point
max_minutes.title: Max Minutes

mode.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode.title: Mode

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

name: reachable_neighborhoods
